links.outcome: Hallucinations in LLM-generated clinical history summaries on manual review
links.effect: 25 total hallucinations across 90 cases; one considered capable of altering image interpretation in a case with borderline radiographic features.
links.quote: Manual review identified 25 total hallucinations across 90 cases, of which one was considered capable of altering image interpretation in a case with borderline radiographic features.

unlisted_practices: Presenting brief narrative LLM summaries rather than detailed structured timelines to improve radiologist preference and readability

screen.reason: The study evaluated radiologist preferences and error/hallucination rates comparing different presentation formats (brief narrative vs structured timeline) of LLM-generated clinical history summaries.
